newsitem.title: USA: Travelers Group sets 4-for-3 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Travelers Group sets 4-for-3 stock split.

text.p: The Travelers Group said on Wednesday it declared a four-for-three split in the company's common stock, in the form of a 33-1/3 percent stock dividend.
The split will be payable November 22 to shareholders of record November 4.

This stock dividend will be made concurrently with the company's regular fourth quarter cash dividend, also approved Wednesday, of $0.15 per share on a pre-split basis, payable November 22, 1996 to shareholders of record on November 4.

The board also declared its intention to maintain this $0.15 per share cash dividend after the split, which will represent a 33-1/3 percent increase in the quarterly dividend when the next dividend is paid in February 1997.
